$comment: How this app is deployed, for the tools that deploy it (ADR 0184). It describes docker-compose.prod.yml and never the development loop, and nothing in it is read by the running app. It is PARTIAL: a service it does not name is not its business, so add a worker, a scheduler or a store to the profile and nothing here objects. `terp verify --only deployment` checks only that what it CLAIMS is true: each unit is a service of the profile, a restated command or dependsOn is the profile's, an env name reaches the unit, a kind unit runs exactly the datastore table's image, a unit without kind is built from this checkout, a migrations label is owned, and the api serves its health paths. A key this vocabulary does not have is refused; a key starting with $ is a comment. There is no image key. Deploy policy (who may publish, approvals, access, gate policy) never belongs here. If no tool can drive this deploy, replace the whole file with {"unmanaged": true, "reason": "why"}. The template writes this file once, at copier copy, and never on an update: it is the app's. See `terp guide deployment`.
